stem:
Fig. 6.1 shows a capacitor of capacitance *C* connected in series with a resistor of resistance *R*.

[[fig:f1]]

Initially the switch is open and there is a p.d. of 12 V across the capacitor.

At time *t* = 0, the switch is closed so that there is a current *I* in the resistor.

Fig. 6.2 shows the variation of *I* with *t*.

[[fig:f2]]

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the shape of the line in Fig. 6.2.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the time constant *τ* of the circuit in Fig. 6.1.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use your answers in (b) to determine capacitance *C*.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.1
figures.alt: A series circuit containing an open switch, a capacitor labelled C and a resistor labelled R.

figures.caption: Fig. 6.2
figures.alt: A graph of current I in mA against time t in seconds, showing a decreasing curve that gradually levels off.
